'''Beam actuators''' were components used in [[Beamdrill/Legends|beamdrills]] that were similar to [[Actuating module/Legends|actuating modules]]. Energy created by the interaction of [[Fuel slug/Legends|fuel slugs]] and charged catalysts flowed into the beam actuator which generated an energized [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] beam.<ref name="EGWT" />
